description:
Cast Heart of Ramos by paying its mana cost.
When Heart of Ramos enters, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
When the Kor Ally enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Heart of Ramos.
Activate Heart of Ramos by sacrificing it.
Haru triggers, returning Heart of Ramos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
